title: Knock on a door. Get candy, or get cursed.
blurb: A multiplayer Halloween game in your browser. Knock on doors for candy, real $CoC, or a jump scare.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
Candy or Curse is a multiplayer Halloween game in your browser. Free, on PC or phone.

You walk a haunted street in costume, bucket in hand, and knock on doors. Most give you candy. Some jump scare you.

Knock, knock

A neighbour opens up and drops a sweet in your bucket. Or the porch light dies and something lunges at the camera. Eight scares, each with its own monster.

Get scared and your candy spills on the lawn for anyone to grab.

Hold $CoC, get paid in $CoC

Hold $CoC and sign in with one free signature. Now some of your treats pay real $CoC, straight to your wallet.

Paid treats come from creator fees, and every one buys $CoC. A bigger bag gets a bigger bucket, up to double the treat.

Level up, open the town

Hollow Lane is the start. Level up to open the Graveyard, the corn maze, Scream Park and Witch Woods. Fly over all of it on a broom.

Every 15 to 25 minutes the Big House rings its bell and opens for 90 seconds. Get in fast.

Come knock

Play free at candyorcurse.fun

Follow @candycurseSOL on X.

What did your first door give you?
